results.description:
From Croydon to the former Eastern Bloc, Super Hans lays it all out – bad trips, deep thoughts and absolute bangers.

This is not a celebrity memoir.

It's a love story, a travelogue, a chemical odyssey and, in many ways, a very long apology.

Superhans has been a musician, a father, an addict, a romantic and, briefly, the sort of man people cross on the street to avoid.

Now, he's bombing across Europe with his oldest mate, dodging trouble, bad memories, and the consequences of several truly world-class decisions, trying to find his way back to the only two people that ever really mattered.

Moreish is funny, chaotic, heartfelt and completely off its nut: the (mostly true) story of how he lost the plot, kept the receipts and somehow lived to tell the tale.

Reviews

'A novel that goes to some surprisingly profound and moving places' i

'Moreish is…well… moreish! No one is more qualified to continue Super Hans’ story than Matt King. Brilliantly funny and oddly insightful.' Metro

'Superhans is already one of the great comedy characters of the Millennium. Finally we hear from the man himself and it’s a hilarious and surprisingly gripping adventure he takes us on. It’s very more-ish.' Richard Herring

About the author

Super Hans – real name Simon, not that he’s ever used it – is a musician, DJ, philosopher, and all-around cultural disruptor. Known as Jez’s best mate and Mark’s worst nightmare in Channel 4’s cult classic Peep Show, he rose to legendary status thanks to his unforgettable lines, unfiltered wisdom, and habit of turning up exactly where you least expect him. His upcoming memoir is the legendary story of a modern folk anti-hero, written in his own gloriously chaotic words.
